response.sql: WITH equipment_averages AS (SELECT e.equipregistry AS equipment_ref, AVG(se.humepct) AS avg_humidity FROM equipment AS e LEFT JOIN scanenvironment AS se ON se.equipref = e.equipregistry GROUP BY e.equipregistry), overall AS (SELECT AVG(avg_humidity) AS all_equipment_avg FROM equipment_averages), above_average AS (SELECT ea.equipment_ref, ea.avg_humidity, o.all_equipment_avg FROM equipment_averages AS ea CROSS JOIN overall AS o WHERE o.all_equipment_avg IS NOT NULL AND ea.avg_humidity > o.all_equipment_avg), group_average AS (SELECT AVG(avg_humidity) AS group_mean FROM above_average) SELECT a.equipment_ref, a.avg_humidity, a.avg_humidity - a.all_equipment_avg AS above_all_equipment_avg, a.avg_humidity - g.group_mean AS difference_from_group_mean FROM above_average AS a CROSS JOIN group_average AS g WHERE g.group_mean IS NOT NULL ORDER BY difference_from_group_mean DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 10;
